findings.summary: ThemeName is exported twice from packages/core/src/themes/index.ts — explicitly from ThemeProvider.tsx and implicitly via export * from './themes'. TypeScript 5.x raises a duplicate-export compile error (TS2308). Fix: remove export type ThemeName = string from themes.ts.

getStoredTheme() returns any localStorage string without validation. The value reaches document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', ...) and is concatenated into a CSS selector string inside generateThemeCSS, which is written to a style tag via textContent. A corrupted or crafted value can produce malformed CSS. Fix: validate against BUILTIN_THEMES + Object.keys(themes) before accepting; fall back to defaultTheme on mismatch.

When a ThemeName does not match any builtin or registered custom theme, resolveThemeCSS silently returns LIGHT_CSS with no developer-facing signal. Fix: add a console.warn or an optional onUnknownTheme callback prop so configuration gaps are surfaced at runtime.

_LIGHT_ENTRIES is a build-time snapshot. If build-w3c.mjs is re-run without rebuilding core, custom theme baselines will silently lag behind token changes. Recommend adding a turbo task dependency or a contributor note.
